method.correction: CLI executions are fresh and the independent comparisons run in separate processes after both CLI children exit. method.statistics: Median/minimum/maximum/mean/stdev/q1/q3/IQR from all seven observations; statistics.quantiles(n=4,method=inclusive); ratios are paired C/B ratios, not ratios of medians.
